description: Community energy demand is a data set deposited in CORA.Repositori de Dades de Recerca by its authors Fco. Ignacio Gamero, Joaquim Melendez (University of Girona). This dataset contains hourly aggregated energy data collected from a real-world renewable energy community between January 1, 2025, and February 27, 2026. It has been published to support the development, validation, and benchmarking of data-driven methods for renewable energy communities, providing a realistic representation of their operation over more than one year. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: TXT. Size stated: 386827. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
